title: Compatibility scenario (compat/scenarios/<id>.json)
description: PLT-R530. Executed by compat-harness on the self-hosted runner only. Twin of TestSupport/Scenario/Scenario.swift. License: LicenseRef-App-Pending.

expect.description: At least one expectation. Written as anyOf over required keys because the CI validator has no minProperties keyword.

noPlaceholderResidue.description: PLT-R422: no read-back text (the key script's and every repeat word's) contains the placeholder U+200B.

repeat.description: PLT-R422 gate (section 4 acceptance): after the key script passes, `words` randomised words of the Telex soak corpus drawn with `seed`, each typed after `prefix` at `timing` and read back on its own; every word must read back as exactly its corpus text. Needs method telex and an ax or webdriver readback. A rule that enables the placeholder needs a test scenario with words >= 1000, timing burst and expect.noPlaceholderResidue true (compat-lint).

prefix.description: Typed before every word; leaves the field empty or its content selected, so the word replaces it.
